Alchemy Shop - NSFW TF Game

Introduction

Welcome to the Alchemy Shop!

Here you act as Harri, a 22yr old apprentice alchemist, learning the art of potion mixing on your journey to becoming a master alchemist. Assisting you is 23yr old Princess Serra, who has volunteered to be the test subjects for all potions you make!

These potions have a huge variety of effects and thus explore a multitude of different transformations, body modifications, costumes, and references.

This game features:

  • Over 200 transformations, body modifications, and costumes!
  • 18 unique s*x scenes
  • 28 achievements
  • 2 minigames

Game is best experienced at 1080p.

Mobile: This game is coded in pure HTML5 and JS, and thus should be playable on mobile. Resources need some time to load however. Additionally, it has not been fully play tested on mobile.

How to Play

Tabs

There are three tabs available:

  • Ingredients: Includes a list of all 22 ingredients which you may use to mix recipes
  • Recipes: Includes a list of all learned recipes. You may also search recipes you’ve discovered using the available search bar
  • Achievements: A record of all earned achievements

Basic Mixing

  • Open the “Ingredients” tab
  • Select any two ingredients. They will then appear in the mix menu at the top
  • Click the “Mix” button and voila!
  • Click the “Clear” button to clear the effects of the transformation, resetting Serra to her normal form (and ready for your next transformation)

This guide is also available if you wish to see all recipe combinations:

Alchemy Shop - Mixing Guide - Google Sheets

Post-Mixing Actions

Some effects allow interactions. These can include:

  • Progression: Clicking “Give More” allows you to give a second dose of the potion, leading to more extreme effects.
  • Swap View: Some effects are viewable from alternate angles by clicking “Swap View”
  • Special: These are s*x scenes between you and Serra. Some feature multiple scenes that you may toggle between using the “Next” and “Previous” buttons.
  • Minigames: Two transformations feature unique minigames. Simply click the “Minigame” button to play.

Secondary Mixing

A handful of potions are available for secondary mixing. In other words, you can mix two recipes together to create a new recipe!

  • Open the “Recipes” tab
  • Find recipes which feature an “>” sign
  • Select two such recipes and click “Mix”

Not all recipes can combine with one another, only very specific ones. It is up to you to find them and mix them!

Tip: In the recipe search, using the search term * will bring up all recipes available for secondary mixing.

Settings and Configs

The bottom right corner of the screen shows the current transformation.

The bottom left of the screen shows help text for all available configurations. Pressing the associated key will toggle the setting.

  • F1: Hide UI
  • F2: Toggle Music - Music is Off
  • F3: Toggle SFX - SFX is On
  • F4: Hide Help
  • Del: Reset Game

Save Data

Data is automatically saved between browser sessions using local storage. Closing the game and coming back to it later will retain all learned recipes and earned achievements. This would be cleared however if browsing data and cookies are cleared.

Pressing the "Del" on your keyboard opens a prompt which will allow you to reset the game as well (clearing all learned recipes and earned achievements)

Limitations

A large limitation will be the quality of the animations. These are not true animations but instead videos which are on loop. Unfortunately this means the quality of the animations will vary.
